Could you advise which of your machines would be best suited to this work? I would be grateful to know whether one machine can handle both small saplings and larger limbs, or whether two would be required. Because of the limited use, I am not looking for anything commercial-grade. Storage in an unheated shed is also a consideration.

I would appreciate a recommendation and an indication of how to place an order.

Respectfully,
Gregory Ashworth

My brother lives in another state and has been asking me to sort the garage, the attic, and the barn, which is a rather large job.
